about_short_description.short_description: Eze is a B2B marketplace for electronics allowing buyers and sellers to trade in wholesale quantities with real-time market data.

product.name: Eze Wholesale Electronics Marketplace
product.description: A B2B marketplace for buying and selling new, used, and refurbished electronics in wholesale quantities, including smartphones, laptops, tablets, accessories, gaming consoles, and other consumer devices.

product.name: Eze Bidding
product.description: A wholesale purchasing feature that lets buyers submit offers for electronics at specified prices and purchase devices at available asking prices.

identifier.value: Wholesale Electronics Market Data and Business Dashboard

product.name: Wholesale Electronics Market Data and Business Dashboard
product.description: A data and dashboard service providing real-time and historical market information, sales tracking, growth metrics, and trends in top-selling electronics models.

product.name: Device Grading and Inspection
product.description: A device evaluation service that tests, sanitizes, data-wipes, and assigns condition grades to new, used, and refurbished electronics offered on the marketplace.

product.name: Seller Enablement and Wholesale Fulfillment
product.description: A platform service for verified sellers to apply, publish electronics inventory, fulfill buyer requests, ship devices for inspection, and receive payment after successful delivery.

identifier.value: Wholesale Order Processing, Payments, and Shipping

product.name: Wholesale Order Processing, Payments, and Shipping
product.description: A transaction service that coordinates payment processing, warehouse inspection, order fulfillment, and tracked domestic or international delivery for wholesale electronics orders.
